Q5002.reason: The ban covers all private casinos alike, so it is an incidental dormant Commerce Clause burden judged under Pike balancing, not a per se invalid discrimination against out-of-state owners.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest in the sister's children who reach 25 can vest too remotely under the common-law RAP and is stricken, leaving the friend with a fee simple absolute.

Q5010.reason: Section 2 of the Thirteenth Amendment authorizes Congress to ban private as well as public racial discrimination in real-estate transactions as a badge of slavery, unlike the Fourteenth Amendment's state-action limit.
